evaluations.label: A

claims.evidence: “Northwind Robotics reported third-quarter revenue ... for the quarter ended September 30”; the required Thursday timing is omitted.
“revenue of $412 million ... up 23% year-over-year”
“above analyst expectations of $389 million”
“Net income rose to $47.2 million, or $0.94 per diluted share, from $31.5 million, or $0.63 per share, a year earlier.”

“We are seeing unprecedented demand for our autonomous fulfillment systems,” said CEO Marta Lindqvist ... “Our order backlog now stands at $1.8 billion, which gives us exceptional visibility into 2027.”
“PickStream platform grew 61%”
“the services segment expanded 18%”
“International sales accounted for 34% of total revenue, up from 28% a year ago.”
“Gross margin fell to 41.3% from 43.1%.”
“CFO David Chen attributed the decline to elevated component costs and tariff-related pressures.”
“a 3% workforce reduction, affecting approximately 210 positions ... expected to save $25 million annually”
“raised its full-year revenue guidance to $1.58 billion to $1.62 billion, from $1.52 billion to $1.57 billion previously”
“Shares rose 6.8% in after-hours trading”

evaluations.rationale: Exceptionally concise and readable financial-news prose. It preserves every inventoried claim except the weekday, and its treatment of the workforce reduction is especially clear.
